effects.effect: Staying light on your feet lets you quickly get back into position. Whenever you are [force moved](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement), you can use a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) to [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) 1 square after the [forced movement](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) is resolved.
